subject: Intermittent conversation stall impacting streaming chat — TidalTech
messages:
From: Mike Huang <mike.huang@tidaltech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@tidaltech.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: production — interactive chat experiencing stalls

Vanessa / team,

We're seeing repeated stalls in our live customer-facing chat sessions between 07:50 and 08:00 PT. The UX shows long pauses (~8-12s) between streaming chunks and sometimes a full stall where the socket stays open but no tokens arrive for ~20-30s. This started after your 07:30 deployment window but looks intermittent across geo-shards.

Impact: affects ~4% of sessions (rough estimate from our metrics) during peak. We had one customer escalate to their success team.

What we need: immediate workaround and ETA for fix. Can you confirm if this is isolated to our account or broader? We've attached a small telemetry snapshot and our adjusted client retry settings.

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Huang
Head of Platform
TidalTech

Immediate next steps from our side (short window):
- Sean will ingest your telemetry and correlate with our shard-level token pacing metrics.
- We'll temporarily enable a per-connection shorter prefix-caching TTL and a conservative token-burst cap for your project to reduce KV cache churn (this is a low-risk change we can roll back).
- We'll share a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MPA) with proposed temporary fallbacks and a postmortem timeline.

We take this seriously — expect an update within 45 minutes. If the degradation is blocking customer workflows we can also open a priority incident bridge; tell me if you'd like that.

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: production — interactive chat experiencing stalls

Mike, Vanessa — I've reviewed the snapshot and correlated it with runtime traces. Quick summary of current findings: 
- Around 07:34 PT we see a transient spike in prefix invalidations on edge-shard eu-west-1 and us-west-2 that increases KV cache misses.
- The serving runtime fell back to short-path execution which increased per-token latencies; for some long-lived sessions this produced chunk gaps of ~15-25s.
- This pattern aligns with a kernel selection regression we rolled for a small subset of instances during the 07:30 deploy.

Temporary mitigations applied (08:52 PT):
- Rolled back the kernel selection tweak for shards serving TidalTech traffic.
- Applied a per-project token-burst cap of 64 tokens and reduced prefix-cache TTL to 30s for TidalTech to reduce inter-shard cache thrash.
- Enabled additional telemetry hooks for your sessions to capture granular token timing.

Immediate recommendations for TidalTech clients (short-term, reversible):
- Client: set streaming fallback to reconnect-on-silence at 12s (instead of 20s) and enable ephemeral chunk reassembly in the client to handle short pauses.
- Server: keep the per-project conservative configs for 2-4 hours and monitor.

I will coordinate with infra to produce a root-cause write-up by EOD; Vanessa, I'll send a draft MPA and the rollback timeline for your review.

Attachments I pushed: redwood-telemetry-snapshot-20260712.json (contains shard-level token timing)

-Sean
Sean Gallagher

sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Huang <mike.huang@tidaltech.com>, ops@tidaltech.com

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: production — interactive chat experiencing stalls

Mike — quick status and next steps.

What happened (summary):
- A kernel-selection configuration we shipped to improve long-tail throughput for certain attention patterns caused unexpected prefix invalidations under a small traffic mix. For some active streaming sessions this produced gaps between token chunks (the client socket remained open but no tokens were served).

What we did (customer-facing actions):
- Rolled back the kernel tweak for impacted shards.
- Applied temporary conservative per-project runtime configs (token-burst cap + reduced cache TTL) for TidalTech at ~08:52 PT.
- Advised client-side shorter reconnect-on-silence (12s) and ephemeral reassembly to reduce perceived stalls.

Impact and current state:
- Incident window: ~07:30–09:10 PT with the most pronounced gaps between 07:34–08:10.
- Observed affected sessions: ~3.8% of TidalTech traffic at peak. After mitigations we saw drop to ~0.4% in the following hour.

Next steps and MPA: 
- We will produce a full postmortem (root cause, timeline, corrective actions) by 2026-07-13 17:00 PT and share with your platform team.
- We'll keep the conservative runtime configurations for a rolling 4-hour observation window then evaluate a staged rollout of the optimized kernel selection with extra canary traffic controls.
- I attached a short MPA PDF that documents the temporary controls and rollback checkpoints; please review and sign off if that plan works for you.

If you'd like a live call to walk through the telemetry and the MPA, I can schedule 30 minutes with Sean and Grace this afternoon.

Thanks again for the quick heads-up — we recognize the customer impact and will prioritize stability and transparency on follow-up.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
